title: Tax
disclaimer: For orientation only, not tax advice. Gains and losses are netted in one pot per regime (the real share-specific Verlusttopf is narrower), no church tax, no solidarity surcharge on §23 gains, no partial-sale optimisation.

liquidation.title: If I sold everything now
liquidation.subtitle: As of {{date}}
liquidation.taxFreeHint: Gains on positions that have passed the speculation period
liquidation.excluded_one: {{count}} position without a market price is not included.
liquidation.excluded_other: {{count}} positions without a market price are not included.

capitalGains.title: Saver's allowance (§20)
capitalGains.hint: A true allowance: only what exceeds it is taxed. Applies to shares, ETFs, bonds, dividends and interest — holding period is irrelevant.

privateSale.title: Exemption limit (§23)
privateSale.hint: A Freigrenze, not an allowance: reach it and the entire gain becomes taxable, not just the part above it. Applies to crypto and physical precious metals — and only while they have been held for less than a year.
privateSale.exceeded: Exceeded — the entire amount is taxable.
privateSale.personalRateHint: §23 gains are taxed at your personal income tax rate, not at 25%.

vorabpauschale.title: Advance lump sum {{year}}
vorabpauschale.hint: Debited by your broker in early January, and it consumes the saver's allowance before any sale does. Cairn cannot calculate it (that needs the BMF Basiszins) — enter the amount from your statement.
vorabpauschale.yearHint: The year it was debited — the advance lump sum for {{prev}} flows in early {{year}}.
